summary: Completed public API regression and responsive UI testing for dashboard, navigation, transaction CRUD, CSV import, currency selector, calendar, and reports.

ui_bugs.issue: Calendar heading is hardcoded to Mart 2025 and previous/next month buttons have no handlers; pending API transactions are from September/October 2026 but are displayed on March day numbers.

integration_issues.issue: Bu Ay Gelir and Bu Ay Gider cards use hardcoded report values rather than current transaction data; account balance is not recalculated after transaction create/delete.
Monthly report series is intentionally demo/static data (confirmed in backend implementation); this is MOCKED and should be labeled or computed from stored transactions for live reporting.

action_items: Make calendar month state derive from current date and implement previous/next navigation; match events by year and month, not day number alone.
Compute dashboard monthly income/expense and balance from persisted transactions/accounts, or clearly label demo values.
Replace or clearly label the MOCKED monthly reports series and add a visible report result flow if report buttons are intended to work.
critical_code_review_comments: Transaction create/delete only changes the transaction collection; account balances and dashboard balance are never reconciled, so real-time cash flow/account balance requirements are not met.
Calendar matches pending transactions by day-of-month only and hardcodes March 2025, which can place events in the wrong month/year.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for exercised core flows; known logic gaps reported

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ and UI CSV transactions during API/UI tests and deleted all of them; seeded demo records were not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard, navigation, transaction modal CRUD, CSV control, currency selector, calendar rendering, reports route, and mobile viewport were exercised. Re-test calendar month navigation/date matching and dashboard figures after fixes. Monthly report series remains MOCKED by design.
rca of the issue: The calendar component hardcodes 'Mart 2025' and finds events with only getDate(), while server seed dates use date.today(); this creates a month/year mismatch. Dashboard cards hardcode 209600/53650 and the backend dashboard balance sums accounts without transaction reconciliation, so mutation results do not drive all displayed financial totals.
